# 296_R6FIX.29 (BL-116): invite consume capacity guard moved onto the UPDATE

## Summary

`inviteGate.consume` checked `used_count < max_uses` in the INSERT's SELECT source (statement
snapshot), so two concurrent consumes of a single-use code by different users could both claim
— `used_count=2`, two redemptions, over-redeemed. The fix inverts the CTE: the guarded UPDATE
takes the `invites` row lock and Postgres re-evaluates the qual on the newest version (EPQ), so
exactly one claimant wins; `ins` records a redemption only for a won claim; a `not exists`
guard keeps same-user re-consume seat-free. Also folds dated closures for BL-119-sum
(recipient-PII logs, already fixed `69c62e39`) and BL-120-sum (Resend `idempotencyKey`, already
fixed `69c62e39`).
